compartments.raw_text: The black boxes represent people: susceptible (S in equations in 'The basic model' in Additional file 1)
compartments.text_span: The black boxes represent people: susceptible (S in equations in 'The basic model' in Additional file 1)
compartments.description: Individuals who are at risk of contracting cholera.

compartments.raw_text: The black boxes represent people: infectious (I)
compartments.text_span: The black boxes represent people: infectious (I)
compartments.description: Individuals who are infected with cholera and can transmit the disease.

compartments.raw_text: The black boxes represent people: recovered (R)
compartments.text_span: The black boxes represent people: recovered (R)
compartments.description: Individuals who have recovered from cholera and are immune.

compartments.raw_text: The compartment 'Vaccinated' represents individuals who receive two doses of vaccine, are successfully immunized and are truly immune.
compartments.text_span: The compartment 'Vaccinated' represents individuals who receive two doses of vaccine, are successfully immunized and are truly immune.
compartments.description: Individuals who have received the oral cholera vaccine and are immune.

compartments.raw_text: Other modelers believe that these are important elements and incorporated into their model a compartment for asymptomatic individuals whose bacterial shedding rate are lower than that of symptomatic individuals
compartments.text_span: Other modelers believe that these are important elements and incorporated into their model a compartment for asymptomatic individuals whose bacterial shedding rate are lower than that of symptomatic individuals
compartments.description: Individuals who are infected with cholera but do not show symptoms.

compartments.raw_text: Some modelers argue that these hyperinfectious bacteria hold the key to our understanding of cholera transmission dynamics
compartments.text_span: Some modelers argue that these hyperinfectious bacteria hold the key to our understanding of cholera transmission dynamics
compartments.description: Bacteria that are freshly shed and have a higher infectiousness.
